2610.13594.title: MENTOR: Learning from Failure with On-Policy Pedagogical Intervention
2610.13594.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key driver for Large Reasoning Models, but it is vulnerable to "zero-reward collapse", a training failure where a sudden increase in task difficulty causes the learning signal to vanish. We argue that the conventional approach of discarding these failed trajectories is wasteful, as they contain valuable diagnostic information about the model's cognitive gaps, a bright side that can be leveraged for recovery. Existing solutions, however, often regress to static, "off-policy-style" interventions like pre-defined hint libraries or perform post-hoc refinement, failing to provide the adaptive, forward-looking guidance needed to escape the collapse. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift towards on-policy pedagogical intervention and introduce MENTOR, a multi-agent framework that acts as a live mentor. MENTOR diagnoses the root cause of failure in real-time and dynamically generates targeted, instructional prompts to guide the learning agent's next attempt. As a plug-and-play module, MENTOR integrates seamlessly into existing policy optimization pipelines like GRPO without modifying the training infrastructure. Extensive experiments on math and code generation show that MENTOR effectively mitigates zero-reward collapse, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, it achieves massive average relative gains of up to 78.3% on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct over its base model.
2610.13594.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習從可驗證獎勵（RLVR）是大型推理模型的關鍵驅動力，但它容易受到「零獎勵崩潰」的影響，這是一種訓練失敗的情況，當任務難度突然增加時，學習信號消失。我們認為，傳統上丟棄這些失敗的軌跡是浪費，因為它們包含有關模型認知缺口的寶貴診斷信息，這是一個可以利用來恢復的亮點。然而，現有的解決方案通常退回到靜態的「離策略風格」干預，例如預定義的提示庫，或進行事後精煉，未能提供逃脫崩潰所需的自適應、前瞻性指導。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種向策略內教學干預的範式轉變，並介紹了MENTOR，一個作為實時導師的多代理框架。MENTOR實時診斷失敗的根本原因，並動態生成針對性的教學提示，以指導學習代理的下一次嘗試。作為一個即插即用的模塊，MENTOR無縫集成到現有的政策優化管道中，如GRPO，而無需修改訓練基礎設施。在數學和代碼生成上的廣泛實驗表明，MENTOR有效地減輕了零獎勵崩潰，並超越了最先進的基準。值得注意的是，對於Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，它在其基本模型上實現了高達78.3%的巨大平均相對增益。
